About the Role 
A Data Scientist in Flipkart is required to develop and implement ML or statistical models for the various projects formulated from business and product views. The responsible person should be able to communicate and collaborate with multiple stakeholders representing various teams to better understand the problem at hand. At a fundamental level, the responsible person should be able to dive deep into a problem statement and extract interesting insights as well as solutions. In addition to being a quick learner, a DS is expected to get involved in active research projects with a view to publish them.
About the team The Data Sciences team at Flipkart is on a mission to build systemic intelligence across Flipkart products and the overarching ecosystem. Being India’s largest online marketplace and the most used e-commerce app in India, places Flipkart in a unique position and gives this team a distinctive opportunity — to decipher the richest possible data about Indian consumers. Add the dimension of a vast product selection and a proliferating seller base to that and what you get is a multitude of disruptive possibilities.
In a nutshell, the terabytes of daily data compounded in Flipkart’s data centres offer a dynamic mix of numerical, structured, unstructured, image- and audio-based statistics, all set to define shopping in the future.
At Flipkart, the work of a Data Scientist involves collaboration with the engineering and product teams to ensure a holistic outcome at the product delivery. The flat functional structure within Flipkart engineering enables data scientists to focus on excellence and create a deep sense of ownership at every stage of work.
If you aspire to redefine ‘state-of-the-art’ and create an impact on India’s online shopping landscape, Flipkart’s Data Science team can offer you the right podium to solve challenging real-world problems and take a giant leap in your career as a Data Scientist.
You are Responsible for● Understand Business and product needs and use ML or statistical techniques to provide solutions to those in a time bound fashion.● Communicate and collaborate with business and product teams to have a better understanding of the project so as to be able to drive it within the DS team.● Get involved in in-depth exploration of solutions using various methods and extract statistical insights from data as well as models, which are to be shared with business and product teams.● Active participation in working with new methods and learning new technologies, both in the area of data science and data engineering.
To succeed in this role – you should have the following● B.Tech or M.Tech in CS or Statistics with experience through publications/deployed solutions/projects.● Deep understanding of the algorithms (theory and application) that they have worked on.● Good grasp on the theory and practice of basic statistical models such as regression or clustering and general ML algorithms such as tree, Random Forests, SVM, Boosting, Neural Networks etc. It is not expected that the candidate has actually worked on all these modules.● Strong proficiency in Python or R is necessary.

content.description:
About the Team & MissionThe ML Platform team maximizes the speed, throughput, and hardware efficiency of our production Large Language Model (LLM) inference stack. As models scale and real-time demand grows, post-training optimization and aggressive server-level utilization are our primary levers for delivering low-latency AI at sustainable infrastructure economics.We operate at the intersection of LLM serving engines, post-training compression, and bare-metal accelerator architecture. Our mission is to squeeze maximum compute and memory bandwidth out of every server node—turning heavy foundation models into ultra-fast, cost-efficient endpoints.
Role OverviewWe are hiring a deeply technical Senior / Staff Software Engineer (Individual Contributor) with 8+ years of experience to partner directly with the Leadership in architecting and scaling our LLM inference platform.In this high-leverage IC role, you will serve as our primary technical anchor for inference performance. You will own end-to-end serving architecture, drive post-training optimization pipelines, eliminate hardware bottlenecks, and guide engineers through complex systems challenges.
Key ResponsibilitiesPost-Training Optimization: Architect and productionize model compression and acceleration pipelines—including quantization (FP8/INT8/INT4), distillation, and speculative decoding—to slash latency (TTFT/ITL) while preserving model quality.Hardware & Server Maximization: Drive bare-metal utilization across multi-GPU and multi-node topologies by optimizing memory bandwidth, tensor core occupancy, interconnects, and parallelism strategies (tensor, pipeline, expert, and disaggregated serving).Inference Engine & Kernel Engineering: Extend modern inference frameworks (such as vLLM or SGLang) and build custom fused kernels and batching schedulers to eliminate compute, memory, and CPU host bottlenecks.Profiling & Automated Diagnostics: Build deep telemetry, roofline modeling, and automated bottleneck-detection workflows to pinpoint hardware stalls and prevent performance regressions in production.Technical Leadership: Partner with Leadership to shape our multi-quarter inference roadmap, author high-clarity RFCs and influence hardware capacity decisions.Mentor Junior Engineers: Level up junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on systems coaching.
Minimum QualificationsEducation: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical systems experience.Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in high-performance computing (HPC), ML inference systems, GPU programming, or low-latency distributed infrastructure.LLM Inference Mastery: Proven track record optimizing large-scale LLM serving in production, with a deep understanding of transformer memory footprints, KV-cache mechanics, continuous batching, and latency/throughput trade-offs.Hardware & Systems Depth: Strong grasp of accelerator microarchitecture (compute vs. memory-bound workloads, roofline analysis, memory hierarchies) and multi-GPU server interconnects.Programming Proficiency: Expert-level coding skills in C++ and Python, with experience building low-overhead, production-critical systems software.
Preferred QualificationsGPU & Compiler Internals: Practical experience writing or profiling custom accelerator kernels and working close to ML compilers or runtime execution graphs.Production Compression & Decoding: Track record deploying quantized models or speculative decoding techniques in high-throughput production environments.Open-Source Inference Familiarity: Experience working inside or contributing to modern open-source LLM serving engines and attention libraries.Complex Workload Scaling: Background optimizing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing overhead or ultra-long-context inference workloads.Automated Performance Tooling: Experience building automated benchmarking harnesses, hardware utilization models, or AI-assisted trace debugging tools.
Why Flipkart?Flipkart is India’s leading e-commerce platform, where innovation meets impact at scale. As part of the AI Solutions team, you will shape the foundational AI infrastructure powering experiences for 500M+ users, millions of sellers, and complex supply chains. Flipkart is part of the Walmart-owned Flipkart Group, which includes Flipkart Wholesale, Flipkart Health+, Cleartrip, Shopsy, Flipkart Travels, and Myntra. Join us to build the platforms that make AI at Flipkart possible.

They set the direction and long-term vision for the team, and partner with product, business and other stakeholders to realize it. EMs partner with product teams on key business metrics, lead innovative solutions to complex domain problems, and drive agility in execution by leading by example. 
This role is for a full stack EM with a mobile/app development background: someone who can go deep on both the app (React Native, WebView) and the Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer in Java, and who builds frameworks that enable other teams rather than building one-off features for them.

A key part of the role is framework engineering: building reusable app frameworks, SDKs and tooling that let other engineers and teams ship faster and safer. We want an enabler mindset (building platforms others build on), not a service mindset (building features on request for other teams).

What you’ll needB.E / B.Tech or similar qualification with 10+ years of experience building cutting-edge products, including 2+ years in people management.Strong mobile/app development background, with deep hands-on expertise in React Native and WebView-based app architectures.Strong backend experience in Java, including building Backend for Frontend (BFF) services for high-volume, distributed, high-transaction systems.Proven track record in framework engineering: building and scaling frameworks, SDKs or platforms that other engineers and teams adopt, with an enabler (not service) mindset.Understanding of the full stack from the app layer to middleware and database layer, and experience architecting on cloud platforms such as AWS.Deep understanding of mobile app internals: performance, memory, networking, release and rollout practices, and common app design patterns.Strong partnership with product and business teams, with effective collaboration and communication across multiple stakeholders.

About the Role:
This role drives the acquisition of New To Bank customers for consumer durables loans and while simultaneously governing the financial backbone of the project. This involves acting as the core operational bridge between Flipkart, its technical service provider, and partner lenders. It involves leveraging digital channels and advanced analytics to identify and onboard "New to Bank" individuals. The position contributes significantly to financial inclusion by making credit accessible, managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to disbursement, and overseeing theP&L for this high-growth segment within a FinTech environment.
About the team:
The Flipkart Fintech team focuses on building and expanding financial services for its vast customer base and sellers.Fintech Vertical is increasingly venturing into lending products, including Credit For All, Two Wheeler Financing,Insurtech, Co Brand Cards and more often through partnerships with banks and NBFCs.. Their goal is to simplifyfinancial access for millions of Indians and integrate financial services deeply within the e-commerce ecosystem.You are Responsible for:● Process Optimization: Improve loan processing efficiency and speed by optimizing origination, underwriting,and disbursement workflows, ultimately minimizing turnaround times.
● Daily Reconciliation: The primary objective is to maintain the daily integrity of financial data flows betweenFlipkart and lending partners. Execute daily comparison of all finalized EMI order data between lenderdisbursement records and Flipkart's Account Receivables (AR)
● Discrepancy Management: This involves investigating and resolving all variances detected in the dailyreconciliation process. Investigate the root cause (e.g., system failure, incorrect status update, or timingdifference) for every identified variance.
● Monthly Billing & Settlement: Manage the periodic financial closure and fund transfer process with lendingpartners. Consolidate reconciled monthly data to generate formal billing statements for platform fees andservice charges owed by the lenders.
● Financial Reporting (MIS): Preparation and circulation of critical financial and operational performance data.Prepare standardized Monthly Information System (MIS) reports detailing key financial metrics (e.g.,disbursement volume, revenue realization).
● Compliance & Complaint Resolution: Maintain regulatory adherence and manage high-priority customerescalations. Ensure all financial operational flows and processes strictly adhere to internal policies andrelevant regulatory guidelines (e.g., RBI guidelines for digital lending partners).
● Audit & Governance: Ensure operational readiness and strong control documentation for external review.Compile and organize all necessary financial flow documentation, including reconciliation logs andsettlement proofs, for internal and external audit purposes.
● Operational & Query Resolution: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) and maintain operationaldocumentation. SOP Management: Document, update, and maintain comprehensive Standard OperatingProcedures (SOPs) for all core operational and financial processes. SME Role: Serve as the definitiveSubject Matter Expert for all complex, non-standard financial and operational queries from internal teams(e.g., Finance, Tech) and external partners.
● Process Optimization and Automation: This moves beyond just documenting current processes (SOPs) toactively driving efficiency and scalability. Conduct regular deep-dive analyses of operational workflows (e.g.,discrepancy resolution cycle time, settlement processing duration) to identify bottlenecks and points offailure.
● Financial Risk and Loss Management: This involves proactively identifying, mitigating, and reportingoperational risks that could lead to financial losses. Risk Identification: Establish a comprehensive risk matrixspecifically for the Flipkart EMI program, covering risks like fraud, settlement delays, reconciliation failures,and regulatory compliance breaches.To succeed in this role – you should have the following:● Strong understanding of the Indian lending landscape.● Expertise in risk assessment, and portfolio management.● Proficiency in reconciliation, reporting & complaint resolution● Excellent communication & presentation skills.● Ability to drive digital transformation and process automation in lending operations.
